verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs establish role-based access control, where privileges are granted to roles and roles are assigned to users, and cloned objects inherit granted privileges. Nothing in the pack documents column-level masking policies or row-level access policies, so only the roles half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: column masking policies, row access policies, evidence of multi-team isolation within one warehouse, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, access control reaches tables, columns, and rows — roles plus masking policies — so one warehouse can serve many teams safely

citations.quote: Role-based Access Control (RBAC): Access privileges are assigned to roles, which are in turn assigned to users.
the clone inherits all granted privileges on the clones of all child objects contained in the source object
